title: I-81 corridor UFO flaps
place_text: Norfolk/Langley to Winchester, I-81 to Harrisburg PA, DC, Pax River

tellings.quote: towards Pax River. Uh it's called the I81 corridor and they had historically UFO flaps. I hate to call them that for years, decades.

plain: Dylan Borland, a guest on podcast host Jesse Michels' show, describes what he calls the I-81 corridor, a stretch of the eastern United States running from Norfolk and Langley in Virginia up through Winchester, along the Interstate 81 highway to Harrisburg, Pennsylvania, and over toward Washington DC and Pax River, a Navy air base in Maryland. He says this region has had waves of UFO sightings, which he reluctantly calls "flaps", for years and even decades, and he mentions the TV show Unsolved Mysteries and the researcher Michael Shermer in that context. He raises it to suggest sightings cluster around military sites.
